questions.question_english: According to the explanations provided in the CCS (Conduct) Rules, the term “Government” means:

The Parliament

questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is option D. questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding Rule 20 (Canvassing of non-official or other outside influence):
I. It prohibits bringing political influence to bear upon superior authorities.
II. It prohibits bringing non-official influence to bear upon superior authorities.
III. It applies only to matters pertaining to promotion and not to transfers.
IV. Violating this rule can lead to disciplinary action under the CCS (CCA) Rules.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
options_english: I, II and III only
I, II and IV only
II, III and IV only
I, III and IV only
questions.explanation_english: Rule 20 prohibits bringing political or non-official outside influence upon superior authorities regarding any service matters, including transfers, promotions, and postings. Violations attract disciplinary proceedings under CCS (CCA) Rules, 1965, validating statements I, II, and IV while invalidating statement III, which incorrectly restricts the scope exclusively to promotions.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। नियम 20 राजनीतिक या गैर-आधिकारिक बाहरी प्रभाव को उच्च अधिकारियों पर लाने से रोकता है, जो किसी भी सेवा मामलों, जिसमें स्थानांतरण, पदोन्नति और पदस्थापन शामिल हैं, पर लागू होता है। उल्लंघनों के लिए CCS (CCA) नियम, 1965 के तहत अनुशासनात्मक कार्यवाही होती है, जो बयानों I, II, और IV को मान्य करती है जबकि बयान III को अमान्य करती है, जो दायरे को केवल पदोन्नति तक सीमित करती है।
key_facts: Rule 20 prohibits political and non-official influence on superior authorities.
Violations can lead to disciplinary action under CCS (CCA) Rules.
Printed answer key: (B) I, II and IV only

questions.question_english: If a Government servant applies for insolvency, they must:
options_english: Wait until the court declares them insolvent before informing the office
Report the fact to the Government immediately
Resign from service immediately
Take an advance from the General Provident Fund to settle the matter secretly
questions.explanation_english: Under Rule 17 of the Central Civil Services (Conduct) Rules, 1964, if a public servant applies for or is adjudged insolvent, the employee must immediately report the full facts and legal circumstances to the Government. Maintaining financial solvency is mandatory, and insolvency proceedings must be formally disclosed to administrative authorities.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। केंद्रीय सिविल सेवाओं (आचार) नियम, 1964 के नियम 17 के तहत, यदि एक सार्वजनिक सेवक दिवालियापन के लिए आवेदन करता है या उसे दिवालिया घोषित किया जाता है, तो कर्मचारी को तुरंत सरकार को सभी तथ्यों और कानूनी परिस्थितियों की सूचना देनी चाहिए। वित्तीय स्थिरता बनाए रखना अनिवार्य है, और दिवालियापन की कार्यवाही को प्रशासनिक अधिकारियों को औपचारिक रूप से सूचित किया जाना चाहिए।
key_facts: Rule 17 mandates reporting insolvency to the Government.
Maintaining financial solvency is a key responsibility of government servants.
Printed answer key: (B) Report the fact to the Government

questions.question_english: Under Rule 20, a Government servant is prohibited from bringing or attempting to bring any political or other outside influence to bear upon any superior authority to further their interests in respect of matters pertaining to their service. key_facts: Rule 20 prohibits political influence on service matters.
Approaching an MP for transfer cancellation is misconduct.
Printed answer key: (b) Approaching an MP to request cancellation

questions.question_english: What is the monetary limit for a Group ‘A’ officer to accept gifts from near relatives or personal friends having no official dealings, on occasions such as weddings, anniversaries, or religious functions, beyond which they must make a report to the Government?
questions.explanation_english: Under Rule 13 of the Central Civil Services (Conduct) Rules, 1964, a Group ‘A’ officer may accept gifts from near relatives or personal friends having no official dealings on occasions such as weddings or anniversaries up to a monetary limit of Rs. 25,000 without filing an administrative report to government authorities.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। केंद्रीय सिविल सेवाएँ (आचरण) नियम, 1964 के नियम 13 के तहत, एक समूह 'A' अधिकारी निकट संबंधियों या व्यक्तिगत मित्रों से, जिनका कोई आधिकारिक संबंध नहीं है, शादियों या वर्षगाठों जैसे अवसरों पर रु. 25,000 तक के उपहार स्वीकार कर सकते हैं, बिना सरकारी अधिकारियों को प्रशासनिक रिपोर्ट किए।
key_facts: Rule 13 of CCS Conduct Rules 1964 governs the acceptance of gifts.
Group 'A' officers can accept gifts up to Rs. 25,000.
Gifts beyond this limit require a report to the government.
Printed answer key: (C) Rs. 25,000

questions.question_english: A Government servant’s spouse intends to start a private business. According to the CCS (Conduct) Rules, what is the obligation of the Government servant?
options_english: The Government servant must report if a family member engages in a trade or business.
No obligation exists under the rules, as the spouse is an independent individual possessing full constitutional freedom to work.
The Government servant must formally resign from civil service before the spouse can lawfully commence any private business.
The Government servant must obtain prior administrative sanction before the spouse can register any commercial business enterprise.
questions.explanation_english: The Government servant must report if a family member engages in a trade or business. Under Rule 15(3) of the Central Civil Services (Conduct) Rules, 1964, every public servant is required to report to the Government if any member of their family is engaged in a trade or business, or owns or manages a commercial firm, ensuring transparency regarding potential indirect financial interests.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। यदि कोई परिवार का सदस्य व्यापार या व्यवसाय में संलग्न है, तो सरकारी कर्मचारी को रिपोर्ट करना चाहिए। केंद्रीय सिविल सेवा (व्यवहार) नियम, 1964 के नियम 15(3) के तहत, प्रत्येक सार्वजनिक सेवक को सरकार को सूचित करना आवश्यक है यदि उनके परिवार का कोई सदस्य व्यापार या व्यवसाय में संलग्न है, या किसी व्यावसायिक फर्म का मालिक या प्रबंधक है, जिससे संभावित अप्रत्यक्ष वित्तीय हितों के संबंध में पारदर्शिता सुनिश्चित होती है।
key_facts: Rule 15(3) mandates reporting family members' business engagements.
Ensures transparency in public service.
Printed answer key: (A) The Government servant must report if a family member engages in a trade or business.

questions.question_english: If a government servant is reduced as a measure of penalty to a lower stage in their time-scale (reversion), the authority ordering such reduction must state:
options_english: The period for which the reduction shall be effective
Both the period of reduction and its impact on future increments
Whether, on restoration, the period of reduction shall operate to postpone future increments
Only the monetary quantum of the penalty, leaving the duration to the Accounts Officer
questions.explanation_english: The authority must specify both the period of reduction and its impact on future increments to ensure clarity and fairness in the penalty process. This requirement is crucial for maintaining transparency and accountability in administrative actions, as it allows the affected employee to understand the implications of the penalty on their future earnings and career progression.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। प्राधिकरण को घटाव की अवधि और इसके भविष्य की वृद्धि पर प्रभाव दोनों को स्पष्ट करना चाहिए ताकि दंड प्रक्रिया में स्पष्टता और निष्पक्षता सुनिश्चित हो सके। यह आवश्यकता प्रशासनिक कार्यों में पारदर्शिता और जवाबदेही बनाए रखने के लिए महत्वपूर्ण है, क्योंकि यह प्रभावित कर्मचारी को दंड के भविष्य की आय और करियर प्रगति पर प्रभावों को समझने की अनुमति देती है।
key_facts: Authority must specify the period of reduction and its impact.
Ensures transparency in penalty processes.
Printed answer key: (B) Both the period of reduction and its impact on future increments.

questions.question_english: Given below are two statements: one is labelled as Assertion (A) and the other is labelled as Reason (R). Assertion (A): A Government servant can be subjected to disciplinary proceedings for conduct committed in their private life. Reason (R): Rule 3(1)(iii) mandates that a Government servant shall do nothing which is unbecoming of a Government servant, which includes maintaining dignity and morality even in private life.
options_english: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
questions.explanation_english: Public servants can face departmental disciplinary action for misconduct committed in personal or private life under Rule 3(1)(iii) of the Central Civil Services (Conduct) Rules, 1964. This rule mandates doing nothing unbecoming of a public servant, requiring maintenance of moral integrity, lawful behavior, and personal dignity both inside and outside the workplace.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। सार्वजनिक सेवक निजी या व्यक्तिगत जीवन में किए गए अनुशासनहीनता के लिए अनुशासनात्मक कार्रवाई का सामना कर सकते हैं, जैसा कि केंद्रीय सिविल सेवाओं (आचरण) नियम, 1964 के नियम 3(1)(iii) में कहा गया है। यह नियम एक सार्वजनिक सेवक के लिए अनुचित कुछ भी न करने की अनिवार्यता को दर्शाता है, जिसमें कार्यस्थल के अंदर और बाहर नैतिकता, कानूनी व्यवहार और व्यक्तिगत गरिमा बनाए रखना शामिल है।
key_facts: Rule 3(1)(iii) addresses conduct unbecoming of a public servant.
Disciplinary action can be taken for private conduct.
Printed answer key: (a) Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A

questions.question_english: Which of the following is considered an act of “devotion to duty” as mandated by Rule 3(1)(ii)?
options_english: Consistently working late into the night, even without authorization
Refusing to take casual leave throughout the year
Reporting colleagues’ minor errors directly to the Vigilance Department
Discharging assigned duties faithfully, punctually, and to the best of one’s abilities
questions.explanation_english: Devotion to duty under Rule 3(1)(ii) of the Central Civil Services (Conduct) Rules, 1964 requires every public servant to perform assigned official responsibilities faithfully, diligently, punctually, and to the best of their capacity. It reflects administrative commitment, conscientiousness, and adherence to established professional standards in public administration.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (d) है। नियम 3(1)(ii) के तहत कर्तव्य के प्रति निष्ठा का अर्थ है कि प्रत्येक सार्वजनिक सेवक को अपने निर्धारित कार्यों को ईमानदारी, मेहनत, समय पर और अपनी क्षमता के अनुसार करना चाहिए। यह प्रशासनिक प्रतिबद्धता, सजगता और सार्वजनिक प्रशासन में स्थापित पेशेवर मानकों के प्रति पालन को दर्शाता है।
key_facts: Rule 3(1)(ii) emphasizes the importance of performing duties diligently.
Public servants must adhere to professional standards.
Printed answer key: (d) Discharging assigned duties faithfully,

questions.question_hindi:
सरकारी कर्मचारियों द्वारा पुरस्कारों को स्वीकार करने के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:
I. किसी भी निजी संस्था/संस्थान से पुरस्कार स्वीकार करने के लिए पूर्व अनुमति आवश्यक है। 
II. मौद्रिक घटक वाले पुरस्कारों को बिना अनुमति के स्वतंत्र रूप से स्वीकार किया जा सकता है।

IV. सरकार द्वारा दिए गए पुरस्कारों के लिए कोई पूर्व अनुमति आवश्यक नहीं है।

questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the
acceptance of awards by Government servants:
I. Prior sanction is required to accept any
award from a private body/institution.
II. Awards carrying a monetary component can
be accepted freely without permission.
III. Competent authorities generally discourage
acceptance of awards from private
organizations to ensure impartiality.
IV. Awards given by the Government itself
require no prior sanction.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
options_english: I, II and IV only
I, III and IV only
II and III only
I and IV only
questions.explanation_english: Public servants require prior government sanction to accept awards from private institutions, while government awards require no prior sanction. Competent authorities generally discourage private awards to preserve administrative impartiality. Awards with monetary components cannot be accepted freely without sanction, making statement II false and statements I, III, and IV correct.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। सार्वजनिक कर्मचारियों को निजी संस्थानों से पुरस्कार स्वीकार करने के लिए पूर्व सरकारी अनुमति की आवश्यकता होती है, जबकि सरकारी पुरस्कारों के लिए कोई पूर्व अनुमति आवश्यक नहीं है। सक्षम प्राधिकरण आमतौर पर प्रशासनिक निष्पक्षता बनाए रखने के लिए निजी पुरस्कारों को स्वीकार करने से हतोत्साहित करते हैं। मौद्रिक घटक वाले पुरस्कारों को बिना अनुमति के स्वतंत्र रूप से स्वीकार नहीं किया जा सकता, जिससे कथन II असत्य और कथन I, III, और IV सही होते हैं।
key_facts: Prior sanction is required for awards from private institutions.
Government awards do not require prior sanction.
Printed answer key: (B) I, III and IV only.

questions.question_english: According to the revised Pay Rules, the date of annual increment for Central Government employees is:
options_english: 1st January or 1st July, depending on appointment/promotion date
1st January uniformly for all central government employees across departments
1st July uniformly for all central government employees across departments
The exact anniversary date of the employee’s original joining in service
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is option A. According to the revised Pay Rules, the date of annual increment for Central Government employees is determined based on their appointment or promotion date, which can fall on either 1st January or 1st July. This flexibility allows for a more personalized approach to increments, aligning with the employee's service timeline.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। संशोधित वेतन नियमों के अनुसार, केंद्रीय सरकार के कर्मचारियों के लिए वार्षिक वृद्धि की तिथि उनकी नियुक्ति या पदोन्नति की तिथि के आधार पर निर्धारित होती है, जो 1 जनवरी या 1 जुलाई में से किसी एक पर हो सकती है। यह लचीलापन कर्मचारियों की सेवा की समयरेखा के साथ मेल खाने के लिए एक अधिक व्यक्तिगत दृष्टिकोण की अनुमति देता है।
key_facts: Central Government employees' annual increment dates are based on appointment/promotion dates.
Printed answer key: (A) 1st January or 1st July, depending on appointment/promotion date.

questions.question_english: Rule 4 of the CCS (Conduct) Rules, 1964 relates to:
options_english: General conditions and rules governing public service employment
Employment of near relatives in private firms
Joining of unrecognized service associations or trade unions
Connections with press, radio, and digital media platforms
questions.explanation_english: Rule 4 of the Central Civil Services (Conduct) Rules, 1964 governs the employment of near relatives in private firms. It restricts public servants, particularly Group ‘A’ officers, from permitting family members to accept commercial employment in private firms having official dealings with the officer or department without previous government sanction. This rule is crucial to maintain integrity and avoid conflicts of interest in public service.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। CCS (Conduct) Rules, 1964 का नियम 4 निजी फर्मों में निकट संबंधियों की नियुक्ति से संबंधित है। यह सार्वजनिक सेवकों, विशेष रूप से समूह 'A' अधिकारियों को परिवार के सदस्यों को उन निजी फर्मों में वाणिज्यिक रोजगार स्वीकार करने की अनुमति देने से रोकता है जिनके साथ अधिकारी या विभाग के आधिकारिक संबंध हैं, बिना पूर्व सरकारी स्वीकृति के। यह नियम सार्वजनिक सेवा में ईमानदारी बनाए रखने और हितों के टकराव से बचने के लिए महत्वपूर्ण है।
key_facts: Rule 4 restricts public servants from allowing family members to work in private firms with official dealings.
It applies particularly to Group ‘A’ officers.
Printed answer key: (B) Employment of near relatives in private firms
